Ana (marketing): Final preflight: embargo lift Fri 11:00 PT. We need a one-line changelog, docs anchor, RSVP link, benchmark line for blog hero, and inbound routing mapping. Canary window?
Leo (eng): Canary Fri 07:00 PT, 4h window. Ramp: 10% -> 40% -> 100%. Auto-rollback on error >2.5% or p95 > 1.4xSLO.
Ana (marketing): Great. Leo, quick changelog blurb we can paste?
Leo (eng): "Adaptive KV cache reduces p95 token latency ~15% on extended-context workloads." Bullets: OOM fix for concurrent batching; regional fallback routing.
Max (product): Messaging suggestion: "Faster predictions for longer conversations. Predictable fallbacks when needed." Use the first sentence as hero.
Kara (docs): Docs live at https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v2.3.4. Changelog anchor: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v2.3.4#changelog. Added migration note and tiny Quickstart snippet.
Ana (marketing): Kara, paste the tiny code sample for the blog please.
Kara (docs): ```
# enable adaptive caching
client.configure({"cache":"adaptive","batching":true})
```
Ivy (salesops): Routing plan: RSVP -> SFDC campaign "v2_3_4_launch"; company_size>600 -> AE queue "Enterprise-Global"; others -> SDR nurture. I'll push mapping and run a test.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary start 1723461600, full ramp 1723468800. Dashboard: https://infra.redwood.ai/deploys/launch-172346
Leo (eng): Please avoid heavy social/press spikes first 20m to allow cache warmup. We'll monitor traces and post a 1-line runbook here before canary.
Ivy (salesops): Test RSVP (company_size=1200) passed: SFDC tag applied and AE queue assignment correct.
Ana (marketing): We'll stagger sends: email wave A +30m, wave B +4h; social first post +1h. Drafting announcement now and will post to #marketing-drafts at 09:30 PT for review. Thanks all :rocket:
